title: Integral Tate modules have pro-etale local bases
statement: Let l be a prime and X any scheme with l invertible in Gamma(X,O_X). Let R_X=p_X^*continuousMapRingObj(Z_l) and let T_X=tateModule X l be exactly the inverse limit of the internal free root modules with power transitions of [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. There is a pro-etale covering (u_i:U_i->X) such that mapMod(u_i^*) T_X is isomorphic to the regular module over u_i^*R_X [def-sfb-finite-upper-star]. No quasi-compactness, separation or finiteness assumption is imposed on X.

source.place: Integral inverse limit and pro-etale rank-one local description before scalar extension.

proof.text: Take the single pro-etale cover and compatible finite-level diagram isomorphism of [lem-poincare-compatible-integral-root-bases]. Each covering morphism is weakly etale. Its inverse-image functor is naturally isomorphic to site restriction, hence preserves limits of the countable inverse system. Lift this preservation to mapMod through the module forgetful functors, which compute and reflect limits.

The actual tateModule is the limit of its free root diagram. Use preservesLimitIso for the weakly-etale pullback, map the finite-level natural isomorphism to an isomorphism of limits, and invert the corresponding preservesLimitIso for the residue diagram. By [lem-poincare-integral-residue-module-limit], the residue limit is the regular integral module. Pull back that regular module and apply mapModUnitIso. This gives the required basis over the pulled-back coefficient ring.

proof_origin.place: Actual inverse-limit argument from compatible finite-level bases and the proved coefficient limit cone; weakly-etale inverse image is restriction.

theorem tateModule_locally_trivial
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    : ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty
        (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (𝒰.f i)).mapMod
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ]) X)).obj
              (tateModule X ℓ) ≅ 𝟙_ _)
